description: This course covers topics that are important for preparation of data and features for machine learning. Advances in Artificial Intelligence had enabled impactful applications built on multi-modality data. These data and features present problems to machine learning systems in various ways: the need for dimensionality reduction of feature vectors; data scaling; outliers; features from unstructured data such as audio, picture and video; text processing; and graph. This course teaches students how to handle such problems that occur in the real world.
